name: Haze Man -The Local Hero-
source:
Every day Shoutarou does many part-time jobs just to get by. Even though he is quite skilled at hand-to-hand fighting, he doesn’t make much use of it and lives a simple life, while watched over by his childhood friend Renka. One day, he met an intelligent life form from another planet, Fara, who hailed from a planet called Perel. He risked his life to save her from a thug’s attack and his life then changed completely.

By joining with Fara, he gets an immense increase in his physical ability and also special powers. She transforms into his armor and protects his body from harm. While normally these powers would not be needed in daily life, this resulted in the sudden appearance of Jil, who planned to take Fara back to Perel with him. He must fight Jil’s henchman every day and their heated battles caused a big disturbance in the shopping street. However, it was promoted as a hero show by his company boss Tooko to attract visitors.

What will happen to Shoutarou and Fara? Will they be able to fight off Jil? How will the town revitalization event turn out?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/09/28/september-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
翔太郎每天都会打很多份工来勉强度日。尽管他很擅长肉搏战，但他并不怎么利用它，在他的青梅竹马莲卡的照顾下过着简单的生活。有一天，他遇到了来自另一个星球的智慧生命体法拉，法拉来自一个名叫佩雷尔的星球。他冒着生命危险将她从暴徒的袭击中救了出来，他的生活从此彻底改变。

通过与法拉联手，他的身体能力和特殊能力都得到了极大的提高。她化身为他的铠甲，保护他的身体免受伤害。虽然平时日常生活中并不需要这些力量，但这导致了吉尔的突然出现，他打算将法拉带回佩雷尔。他每天都要与吉尔的心腹战斗，他们的激烈战斗在商店街引起了很大的骚乱。然而，他的公司老板图子将其宣传为英雄表演，以吸引游客。

翔太郎和法拉会发生什么事呢？他们能打败吉尔吗？小镇振兴活动将如何进行？
